lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
خ/ف/ف   kh–f–f light load, a small group of people
; camel’s foot, to travel at ease, (of camels) to travel in single file; to be light, to be light‐hearted, to move quickly, to be quick‐witted; to take lightly, to treat with contempt, to consider as easily influenced, to die.

Of this root, 7 forms occur 17 times in the Qur’an:
خَفَّ khaffa 3 times; خَفَّفَ khaffafa 3 times; يُخَفَّفُ yukhaffaf 5 times;اسْتَخَفَّ ʾistakhaffa 3 times; تَخْفِيفٌ takhfıf 1 time; خَفِيفٌ khafıf 1 time and خِفَافٌ khifāf 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
خَفَّفَ khaffafa [v. II, trans.; pass. yukhaffaf imperf. ofخُفِّفَ khuffifa] to lighten, to lessen

(40:49) ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِنَ الْعَذَابِ ask your Lord to lighten our suffering [even] for one day.

entries.label: اسْتَخَفَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
اسْتَخَفَّ ʾistakhaffa [v. X, trans.]

1 to consider as light, to consider light enough to carry or handle, to take lightly, to make light of

(16:80) وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ جُلُودِ الأَنْعَامِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا and He provided for you from the hides of cattle houses [tents] you find light

2 to consider as easy to influence, to consider as rash and incapable of serious thoughts

(43:54) فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ so, He deemed his people easy to influence and they obeyed him

3 to urge, to hasten (in one interpretation of 43:54) فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ so, He urged his people [to disobey Moses] and they obeyed him.

entries.label: خَفِيفٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
خَفِيفٌ khafıf [quasi‐act. part., pl. خِفَافٌ khifāf]

1 light

(7:189) فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّاهَا حَمَلَتْ حَمْلا خَفِيفًا and when he mated with [lit. covered] her she conceived a light pregnancy

2 lightly armed, lightly equipped; easy moving

(9:41) اِنْفِرُوا خِفَافًا وَثِقَالا وَجَاهِدُوا بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ so go forth, lightly and heavily [armed], and struggle for the way of God with your possessions and your persons.

entries.label: خَفَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
خَفَّ khaffa i [v. intrans.] to be, become or prove to be light or scanty *

(7:9) وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ the one whose scales are light, the one who brought little to the weighing, the one whose good deeds did not weigh much.
